title: AI / LLM Applications Engineer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: AI / LLM Applications Engineer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. LLM Architecture & RAG Pipelines: Chunking strategies, dense/sparse embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone/Qdrant/pgvector), reranking, and semantic caching.
2. Prompt Engineering & Agent Frameworks: Chain-of-thought, tool calling/function execution, multi-agent coordination, and deterministic output schema enforcement.
3. Production LLM Operations (LLMOps): Token budgeting, latency streaming (TTFT), fallback routing across providers, evaluation benchmarks (Evals), and hallucination guardrails.
4. Fine-Tuning & Small Models: LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, dataset curation, and distillation for on-premise/low-latency inference.

sections.heading: Question Strategy & Guidance
lines: - PREFER BRIEF PILLARS: Explore the candidate's actual generative AI pipelines, vector retrieval setups, or agent workflows.
- Assess handling of non-deterministic model responses, context window limits, and prompt injection vulnerabilities.
